purpose: Teach: 羽根/遊戯/製図/海面/浴室/祖父母/出稼ぎ/蔵書

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、羽根つきの遊びをされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard a customer brought their child by to play badminton.
lines.style: Soft, conversational opening. Gentle curiosity mixed with quiet pleasure. Warm remembering tone, as though piecing together details about someone she cares for.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店に小さな遊戯コーナーを作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should set up a small play corner in the shop, don't you think?
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, not directive. Moves from observation to possibility. Light, collaborative energy — imagining something together rather than instructing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、製図のお仕事だってお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our regulars mentioned they work in technical drafting.
lines.style: Gentle recollection. Noticing details about customers that matter. Soft, deliberate — the way she catalogs people's lives without making a fuss about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海面に光が反射するお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they were talking about how light reflects off the ocean surface.
lines.style: Continuing the thread with quiet wonder. Slower pace, lingering on the image. A small smile in the voice — moved by someone else's attention to beauty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新店舗にはお客様用浴室は付けないわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're not putting a customer bathroom in the new location, are we?
lines.style: Dry, practical question with a hint of amusement underneath. Not complaining — just reality-checking. Light, matter-of-fact edge.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様と祖父母と来店して下さったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That same customer came in with their grandchild and their parents.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Small lift in tone — genuinely pleased they brought family. The noting of connection across generations.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、出稼ぎ先から戻ってこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned they'd just come back from working away for a while.
lines.style: Gentle, observant delivery. Acknowledging what wasn't said directly. Slight weight to it — understanding the effort of return.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、蔵書を整理されたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they've been organizing their book collection.
lines.style: Soft, trailing observation. The gentle noticing of how people spend their quiet time. Fading slightly at the end, as though adding one more small, true detail.
